english: I-I'm sorry...
Huh!?\nWhy are you apologizing all of a sudden!?
Um... I was wondering if something was wrong...
Wrong how?\nNothing's wrong.
You just looked like you were having fun.
Ah! That...\nplease don't point that out.
I just hummed without thinking.
It's embarrassing.\nWhy do I just start humming\nwithout realizing...
S-sorry for saying something weird.\nSo, what were you doing?
Preparing everyone's meals.\nI want to do what I can.
I'm no use in battle,\nso I want to help everyone\nin other ways.
That's why I came along.
I see.\nYour cooking is delicious, Siesta,\nso I'm sure it lifts everyone's spirits.
Thank you.\nThat makes me happy to hear.
If you have any requests,\njust say the word.\nRecipe requests are welcome too.
If I think I can make it, I'll give it a try.
And if there's anything you dislike,\ntell me that too.\nI'll avoid it as much as I can.
...Maybe everyone's doing well\nthanks to you, Siesta.
Huh!? What's with the sudden compliment?\nFlattery won't get you anything, you know?
I don't want anything in return...\nAt least I'm glad\nthere's good food.
Hee. Then I'll keep putting\nmy all into the cooking.
You really love cooking...
The head chef usually cooks,\nbut I get to make things sometimes.
Serving the nobles\nis my job, after all.
Is that why you're dressed like that?
By 'like that,' do you mean the maid outfit?
Um... does this outfit look weird?\nI can change if it does...
Or does it not suit me?\nI'm so used to wearing it,\nI never thought about it.
It's not weird, but...\num... it does stand out.
Does it?\nI thought everyone else was\ndressed pretty outlandishly too...
T-true...\nWith so many worlds mixed together,\nit can't be helped.
Not at all.\nIt suits you.\nA real maid is just a rare sight.
Is that so?\nIt was normal in my world.
Still, thank you\nfor saying it suits me.\nThat gives me confidence.
There really are all kinds of worlds.\nPeople who use magic without being nobles...\nclothes I've never seen...
It's so stimulating, so fulfilling.\nDon't you think?
True.\nYou're so positive, Siesta.
You can't be positive?\nThat's terrible!
You must be hungry.\nThat's got to be it.
Let's eat something delicious\nand do our best! Okay?
Hee. Right.
You're not a noble, are you?
Uh, well... of course not...\nNobility doesn't suit me.
I've had a lot of contact with nobles,\nand everyone who could use magic\nwas a noble...
So I get a little nervous.\nI'm a commoner, after all.
A commoner speaking up to a noble\nwas unthinkable.
But you talk to Louise normally, don't you?
Miss Valliere\nis a kind person.
Her words and personality are a bit much,\nshe gets worked up easily, her figure...
She has plenty\nof childish sides.
Even so, Miss Valliere is easy\nfor a commoner like me\nto talk to.
Some nobles are\noverbearing tyrants.
Among them, Miss Valliere has\nthe heart to listen\nto a commoner's words.
You really trust Louise...
Well, she does have a complex\nabout her figure, so that's\nwhere I win!
No noble can do anything\nabout bust size, after all.
Oh, and keep what I just said\na secret from Miss Valliere, okay?
She'd scold me.
Um... aren't you two close...?
Being close with a noble is too presumptuous for me.
I just have things I don't want\nto lose to Miss Valliere in,\nso I end up competing.
Small ones have their fans too, right...
I never expected\nyou to say that.
Do you prefer small?
P-please don't... press your chest against me like that...
...Hee.\nYou're naughty!
But this is where I won't lose\nto Miss Valliere...
I won't let her gloat so easily.\nA commoner can shine when it counts!
(I don't really... understand Siesta and\nLouise's relationship...)
Um... I'm so shocked\nI can't believe my eyes...
Do carriages in other worlds have no horses?
Carriages...?
A box-like thing was running with no horses.
A commoner like me rarely rides carriages,\nso maybe I just didn't know-\nare there modern carriages like that?
A horseless carriage running...
Could you mean... a car?
C-car?\nIs that the name of the running box?\nI've been curious but couldn't ask!
The horses are inside, right?\nI know that much.
No... there are no horses inside.
W-whaa-!!\nThen where are the horses!?
...You're not trying to trick me, are you?\nTrying to make a fool of me...
Um, it doesn't run on horses.\nIt has... a different power source.
Power source...?\nWhat's that?
Is it magic?\nSo it can't run\nwithout magic?
That I could understand.
Um... how do I explain...\nIt's like ordinary people can use\nwhat you'd call magic.
Ordinary people... you mean commoners?\nThen would it run\nif I rode it?
...Yes.
Amazing!? Other worlds have\nsuch technology...\nAnother discovery...
Car... car...\nI hope I can ride one someday.
It's faster than the carriages I know,\nso I might not handle it,\nbut I'm curious.
I'll ride with you then...\nsince you'd be nervous.
Thank you!\nI'd feel so much braver with you there.
...When you ride in a car, you always secure your body, so...
You need a fixing spell!?\nSee! You DO need magic\nafter all!
So a commoner can't ride\nwithout a noble along, right?
Technology other than magic from other worlds\nis beyond my imagination...
So many surprises...
If I asked other people, they'd\nprobably think I'm silly, so...
Please teach me more sometime.\nI'm counting on you.
...Well... I do have this.
...Um... what should I do.\nSiesta looks troubled, but if I\ncalled out to her... I'd be a bother.
Oh? Is something wrong?
Huh!? U-um... well.\n...Could it be... are you having trouble?
Yes...\nI'm actually a little short on ingredients.
Huh? That's terrible!\nYou can't cook?
No, it's not that I can't\nmake today's meals.
Rest assured.\nI'd never do anything to harm\neveryone's health.
I just wanted to make something,\nand I'm a little short on its ingredients.
But it's not urgent, so I'll wait\nuntil I can get them.
What is it?\nMaybe I can get it right away.
Um... I want mushrooms.\nBut it's not that simple...
Mushrooms?\nCouldn't we just look for some?
I looked around, but didn't find\nanything promising.\nIt has to be safe to eat...
That's true...\nGetting sick before a battle would be awful...
Yes.\nI take that seriously,\nyou know.
Since I make the food,\nI handle that properly.
Other than mushrooms?\nIsn't there a substitute?
Tree bark could work...\nbut...
Huh!? Wait a sec.\nThis is cooking... right?
Yes, it is.\nI'm just unsure about the trees\naround here, so I'm uneasy.
...Um.\nWant to look together sometime?\nFor mushrooms.
N-no! It's fine!\nI don't want to trouble you.
Even so, it's something I can\nmake anytime.
So I'll really just make it\nwhenever I feel like it.
I want to try what you want to make, Siesta.\nLet me help.
...Then...\nmay I ask for your help?
Thank you.\nThat's a huge help.
Mushrooms...\nWe have to watch out for poisonous ones.
Hee. Leave it to me.\nI can tell that much apart.
I used to go picking\nin my village a lot.
I'm good at finding edible\nmushrooms and mountain greens.
Oh, looks like we're moving.\nLet's go.\nWe can't hold everyone up.
...Cooking, huh.\nOh, what was she planning to make again?
How about this one?\nIt's really colorful, but...
That one's no good.\nIt's poisonous.
It's pretty, but even\nbugs won't eat it.
Oh, please wash your hands.\nThe itch won't go away otherwise.
Thank you.\nThis one's poison too...\nMost of what I picked...
How do you tell them apart?\nI thought it might come in handy sometime...
Well...\nunfamiliar ones are tricky,\nbut I avoid the pretty ones.
The flashy-colored ones\nare visible to birds too...\nmeaning they're confident they're inedible.
I-I see...\nSo this mushroom is\npoisonous in that sense too...
Poison... could we use it in battle...\nif we can't eat it, at least...
It's not fast-acting poison,\nand getting the enemy to eat it\nwould be hard, don't you think?
Don't look so down.\nUm, if you really wanted to eat it,\nI think you could...
I just don't recommend it.\nFor example... this one!\nThis mushroom probably won't kill you.
It'll just make you throw up nonstop...
L-let's not!\nThat's a no!\n...Too dangerous.
Th-then, this one!\nThis one's milder?
I-if I remember right...\nit should just make your tongue numb.
That one's... also a problem...\nit'd get in the way of fighting.
Right.\nThen how about this one...
Um... you don't have to worry about me.\nPoison is scary... so.\nLet's just gather safe mushrooms.
...Sorry.
You're helping me out,\nand I didn't want to bring you down...
But even just safe mushrooms,\nwe got this many.\nThis is plenty.
Thank you.\nGathering alone is hard,\nso you really saved me.
Glad I could help...\nUm... I forgot to ask,\nwhat dish is this for?
Huh? Didn't I explain?\nIt's my hometown dish.\nIt's called Yoshenave.
Yoshanaabi...?
Yoshenave.\nMy father taught me to make it.
He said he learned it\nfrom his great-grandfather.
The ingredients aren't fixed,\nso it's a really convenient dish\nyou can make lots of ways...
Even so, there are ingredients\nI personally can't leave out.
My little obsession.
And that was... mushrooms?
Well, it's not that I'm obsessed\nwith mushrooms.\nThey're just easy to get.
Now, before prepping the Yoshenave,\nI'll make today's meals for everyone.
I'll make the Yoshenave\nlater on.
...Okay.\nI'm looking forward to it.
Sorry about the other day...
P-please forget about that...\nIt's embarrassing.
Because of me,\nyou ended up in danger.
No, it was my carelessness...
If I hadn't said I wanted\nto add meat to the Yoshenave\nto make it a bit fancier...
Who'd have thought that chasing a piglet,\nyou'd get run over by a boar...
I should've stopped you.\nCatching a fleeing piglet\nis nearly impossible.
And where there's a piglet,\nthere's a parent nearby-I should\nhave warned you to watch out.
When it slammed into me,\nI thought I was done for...
Same here, watching it!\nYou scared me half to death!
I'm glad you're okay.\nDon't risk your life over\nYoshenave ingredients!
But... I'm sorry.\nBecause of me the piglet got away,\nand the boar's on guard now.
More important than that:\ntreasure your life.
Otherwise, what's the point of me\nmaking all this food?
That means... you care\nabout everyone's health...?
Of course!\nWhat else would it be?
N-no... nothing.
That sounds... kind of like a confession.
Hey! Don't tease me!\nI really was worried!
The Yoshenave ingredients\nare fine, though.
Don't worry.\nI caught a wild rabbit\ninstead.
I'm sorry all over again...
I'm used to this kind of thing.\nIt was normal in my village.
You look really tough...
Stop it.\nDon't say it like that.
Would it be better... if I were\nmore... girly?
Huh? Why?
Well, um... that kind of foraging\nwas normal in my village...
I just wouldn't like it\nif what's normal to me looked weird to you...
It's just that in my village it was normal,\nso I wondered if I should\nkeep that side hidden...
Isn't it fine...?\nIt's your wild side.
W-wild...?\nThat doesn't feel like a compliment.
Is 'wild' something girls in your world\nlike hearing?
I'm a little torn...
...Maybe not, actually.
Wha!?\nThen you said something to me\nthat ISN'T a compliment!?
A little more... um...
Ngh-!! Never mind.\nYou need to think more about\nhow girls feel!
Um... what is she angry about?\nI don't get it at all...
I can finally\nmake the Yoshenave!
The rabbit meat is prepped\nand tenderized, so it should\nbe ready to eat soon.
Thank you\nfor all your help.
Is there anything else you need?\n...If there is...
Thank you.\nThe ingredients are perfect now.\nDon't worry.
Yoshenave...?\nAh, your hometown dish, Siesta.
D-did you forget!?\nYou're joking, right?
O-of course!
...I want to eat the Yoshenave soon.
Hee. Were you always\nsuch a glutton?
Knowing someone's waiting for my cooking\nmakes me kind of happy.
It really makes it worth making.
It's your hometown dish...\nI keep imagining how delicious it must be...
I-if you raise the bar that high,\nthat puts me in a bind...
I could make it right away,\nbut we'll be moving soon,\nso I'll hold off for now.
I'm sure you'll like it.\nJust wait a little longer\nin anticipation.
It'll still take a while...?\nWhat if we asked everyone and ate it here...?
That won't work.\nI'm a maid, after all!
Just as I can't waste\nthe nobles' time,\nI can't take up everyone's extra time.
That's absolute.
Is that how it is...?
Besides, I'd like you to be\nthe first to taste it, if possible.
Huh?
You helped me so much,\nI want to repay you.
I think people who work hard\ndeserve a proper reward.\nIt's only right.
My cooking as that reward\nis presumptuous of me, but...
No. Thank you.\nI'm really... happy.
Hee.\nI'll make a perfect Yoshenave.
It'll be a taste you never forget.
Um, wake up.\nWake up.
Nn... huh?\nSiesta...?\nWhere is this? And that outfit...?
Still half asleep?\nThat's what you get for sleeping in the hallway.
Come on, this way.
This place... what was it again?
You're really out of it.\nIt's a cafe. We turned the classroom into one.\nI'm the waitress.
I brought you here to treat you.
Now, sorry to keep you waiting.\nPlease, dig in!
This is my hometown dish, Yoshenave.
It's finally done, and I wanted you\nto taste it first, so I brought it.
I-I'm honored...\nWow... it smells amazing.
Thanks to the mushrooms you picked.
Without those, I couldn't have made the broth.
Try some. Here you go.
O-okay. Here I go...
......... S-so, how is it?
Yeah! It's super delicious!
Great! I was nervous whether you'd like it.
I gathered ingredients across worlds,\nso I worried about the flavor, but it seems fine.
Coming from you, Siesta, I never doubted it'd be delicious.
Hee. Thank you.
Is there anything else you'd like?\nI'd be happy to serve you.
Serve me!?
I'm a maid who serves nobles,\nbut right now I want to help everyone.
Here, have some tea too.\nWith the Yoshenave, it'll warm you up.
...Okay.\nMm... this tea is delicious too.
It pairs well with the Yoshenave, right?\nThe tea is light, so it\nbrings out the Yoshenave even more.
True... It's this delicious, huh.
I'm really glad you like it.
And I'm glad you got to be\nthe first to taste it.
...Siesta.
Thanks to you, it turned out to be a wonderful Yoshenave.
You've been helping me out a lot lately.
I-it's fine!\nIt's the only thing... I can do.
...Can I keep counting on you?\nJust kidding. Hee.
Huh? What was that, Siesta...\nI didn't catch the end...
Siesta... I...
Huh? Did you call me?\nWait, was that sleep-talking?
Come on, wake up already.
Nn... huh?\nSiesta...?\nWait, where's the Yoshenave...?
You've got a good nose.\nI just brought it over.\nYou were asleep, so I was going to wait.
Since you're awake,\nplease try some.
O-okay... *munch*.\nYeah! It's really delicious!\nThat's our Siesta!
Really! Greatt!\nEat as much as you like!
If I'm the first one eating this...\nthen Siesta really is...
Oh, I have to take this to everyone soon.\nThe Yoshenave will get cold.
Huh? Um...
Honestly, with all the different worlds,\nI was worried it wouldn't taste right.
Having you taste it showed me\nit's just like always.
Thank you.
Oh, sure...
I'm sure everyone\nwill enjoy it too!
Well then, thank you very much!
...So I was just the taste-tester...?\nNo way...
...Where am I supposed to put\nall this pounding in my chest-?!
